user.title: Choose your lights
user.description: Daylight follows the sun, with dim, warm nights and brighter, cooler days. Select lights to start with automatic seasonal timing. Adaptation switches start off; enable them when ready. Night/day levels are optional adjustments below.

data_description.min_color_temp_kelvin: Lower values are warmer. Each bulb uses its supported range.
data_description.max_color_temp_kelvin: Higher values are cooler. Each bulb uses its supported range.

data_description.transition: Fade requested from the bulb, separate from the daily curve. Subject to bulb support.
data_description.adapt_only_on_state_change: Skip periodic adaptation; still adapt when a light turns on or adaptation resumes.
data_description.separate_turn_on_commands: Send brightness and color temperature in separate commands.
data_description.send_split_delay: Delay, in seconds, between the brightness and color temperature commands.

menu.title: Daily schedule
menu.description:
{summary}

Changes remain a draft until you review and save. Cancel to discard. Light levels and selection are edited on each target. [View the saved schedule](/daylight-preview). Opening the preview leaves this form; save or cancel first.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Optional controls for individual transition endpoints, curve shapes and update frequency.

morning.title: Morning timing
morning.description: Move brightness and color together. Their relative timing stays the same.

evening.title: Evening timing
evening.description: Move brightness and color together. Their relative timing stays the same.

lengths.title: Transition lengths

customize.title: Custom timing
customize.description:
Each track has four endpoints. Custom rules are exact and checked across seasons before saving; they are not automatically moved to fit. Unchanged endpoints keep their standard rules. Choose Standard to remove an override. Basic timing controls are hidden while endpoint overrides exist.

{summary}

endpoint_kind.title: Timing rule
endpoint_kind.description: Editing {point}. The current rule is selected. Choose Standard to remove an override, or choose how this endpoint should follow the sun or clock.

endpoint.title: Endpoint timing
endpoint.description: Editing {point}. {meaning} Negative offsets are before the event. This edits the draft only.

shapes.title: Transition shapes
shapes.description: Smooth gently starts and finishes. Linear changes at a constant rate. Shapes never change endpoint timing.

runtime.title: Update frequency
runtime.description: How often Daylight recalculates. This does not change the curve or the bulb’s fade duration.

restore.title: Restore standard timing
restore.description: Replaces all custom endpoint rules and basic timing adjustments with seasonal defaults. Target ranges and transition shapes are kept. Nothing changes on your lights until you save.

save.title: Save schedule
